manifest_name: Project Black Knight Recommendation Quality Benchmark Manifest

held_out_relevance_benchmark_v2.provenance: Human-verified catalog entity judgments; independent of model predictions

metric_definitions.Hit@5: Fraction of queries with at least one grade >= 2 item in top 5
metric_definitions.Hit@10: Fraction of queries with at least one grade >= 2 item in top 10
metric_definitions.MRR: Mean Reciprocal Rank: 1 / rank of first item with grade >= 2 (within top 10)
metric_definitions.nDCG@10: Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain at rank 10: sum((2^rel - 1) / log2(rank + 1)) / IDCG@10
metric_definitions.Recall@50: Fraction of all relevant items retrieved in candidate pool of 50
metric_definitions.Recall@100: Fraction of all relevant items retrieved in candidate pool of 100
metric_definitions.Constraint Violation Rate: Percentage of returned items violating hard metadata bounds
